Fixes submission review issues for the first public release.

- Production builds work from source archives without Git metadata, personal books, or a development vault.
- Quote colors use CSS properties on rendered callouts instead of injecting style elements. Color reordering uses a CSS variable for row positioning.
- Settings use searchable definitions and the current refresh API.
- Window timers and animation frames use the browser APIs explicitly. Values from settings, PDF outlines, and component callbacks have explicit types or validation.
- CSS avoids `!important`, `clip-path`, and `display: contents`.
- Release assets are built and attested by GitHub Actions. Verify a downloaded file with `gh attestation verify main.js --repo andy-spike/obsidian-reader-plugin`.

Requires Obsidian desktop 1.14.4 or newer. Runtime checks cover Linux; macOS and Windows remain unverified. This release reads text PDFs. EPUB, OCR, and AI assistance remain planned.

For Obsidian Sync, choose a visible annotation folder in Reading Desk settings. Obsidian Sync skips the default hidden annotation folder.
